inv.desc_es:
Local en venta en el barrio de Sant Gervasi-Glavany con licencia C-3 RESTAURACIÓN MIXTA. Consta con una superficie de 378,35 m2, distribuidos en dos plantas y un altillo. La planta calle tiene una superficie de 154m2, sótano de 154 m2 y altillo de 70 m2. Además el local tiene dos terrazas, una en la calle y otra en el altillo que da al interior de la manzana. Las terrazas son nuevas y muy aprovechables.
-Contrato firmado el 01/01/2023. Vencimiento 10 años. A partir del 11º año renovación anual.
-Desistimiento del arrendatario con 2 meses antelación.

inv.desc_en:
Premises for sale in the Sant Gervasi-Glavany neighborhood with C-3 MIXED RESTORATION license. It has an area of 378.35 m2, distributed over two floors and a loft. The street floor has an area of 154m2, a basement of 154 m2 and a loft of 70 m2. In addition, the place has two terraces, one on the street and another on the loft that overlooks the interior of the block. The terraces are new and very usable.
-Contract signed on 01/01/2023. Maturity 10 years. From the 11th year onwards, annual renewal.
-Withdrawal of the tenant with 2 months notice.
-Annual income €3,000 per month + VAT
-Exempt from CCPP.
- IBI: 2,033 euros per year
-PROFITABILITY of 4%
If you may be interested in this property or want to know our extensive product portfolio, contact the Investment Department of Fincas Siglo XXI, we are a leading company in the sector with a long history. Our consultants will find the property that best suits your needs.
Reference: 006.11416.
